subheader: One card per programme, each with its proof
lead: Each entry has an icon, the discount and one line on how to prove eligibility. Naming the proof saves readers from having to ask.
note: The note holds the rules for all programmes: whether they combine, what they apply to and how long they last.

programmes.title: The title states the discount
programmes.text: Readers see the amount before they open anything. This card links to the template.

programmes.title: The link leads to the proof
programmes.text: Point it at the application step. The element itself checks nothing.

programmes.title: The whole card is one link
programmes.text: Its title names the link, so a screen reader announces where it goes.

programmes.title: Two to four columns
programmes.text: The grid fits the space it has, not the width of the screen.
